actions.name: GENERATE_FIELD_VOLUME
actions.sideEffect: SELECT-only saved result export. Source file summaries retained as planning values; no ERP writes.

actions.name: GENERATE_UPLOADED_FIELD_VOLUME
actions.sideEffect: Authenticated file-only conversion. Zero database queries or writes; no matching or apply prerequisite. Source weekday, units and summaries preserved. Optional pasted/embedded farm notes validated; unresolved notes retained. Previous subweek not inferred.

crossYearFixture.description: 2025/46-01 excluded from 2026/46-02; same actual date and prior subweek only; future subweek excluded.

sourceSummary.rule: Sum distinct physical source rows for the same matched product exactly once; deduplicate customer columns and repeated name blocks. Preserve original formula cached zero values. Infer blank zero only from the source equation.
sourceSummary.nearMiss: Reject one physical row mapped to multiple product keys or conflicting per-unit conversion factors.
sourceSummary.staleFormat: field-volume-v1 tokens are rejected before DB access; revalidation issues field-volume-v2.
